weddingchecklistpdf.com.name: Wedding Checklist PDF
weddingchecklistpdf.com.definition: Wedding Checklist PDF is a $9 wedding planning checklist with a 104-row editable master list and a 13-page printable packet. It organizes tasks by planning window from twelve months out through wedding week, with owners, dependencies, priorities, deadlines and final payments, so couples can see what is due and who is doing it.

faqs.question: What is included in the Wedding Checklist PDF?
faqs.answer: A 104-row editable master checklist, planning-window worksheets from 12+ months through wedding week, separate wedding-week and final-payment trackers, and a 13-page printable PDF, delivered with an editable XLSX workbook and a setup CSV.

faqs.question: Is the Wedding Checklist PDF a subscription?
faqs.answer: No. It is a one-time $9 purchase. Pay once and keep the current release for personal use.

faqs.question: How are the files delivered?
faqs.answer: Stripe handles checkout and payment verification. Verified purchases unlock the protected files on the success page and by email, and order and access help goes to info@weddingchecklistpdf.com.

faqs.question: Do I need a wedding planner to use this?
faqs.answer: No. The checklist is built for couples planning the wedding themselves. Every task has a planning window, an owner, dependencies and a deadline, so you can see what is due and who is doing it without hiring anyone. It is a set of files, not a person: nobody plans the wedding for you.

faqs.question: How much does a wedding planner cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on where you live and how much the planner does: full planning costs the most and day-of coordination the least. The Knot publishes current averages at theknot.com/content/how-much-do-wedding-planners-charge. This checklist does not replace a planner's judgement; it gives you the planner's checklist, dated from your wedding day, for the $9 price.

faqs.question: Can a friend run our wedding day with it?
faqs.answer: Yes. The separate wedding-week and final-payment trackers list what happens that week and who pays whom, so a friend, a parent or the venue's coordinator can work from the same pages you planned with. The Day-of Coordinator Checklist guide covers the day itself.
